chapterInfo.content:
13
Yesu hohoro asuafoɔ no nan ase
1Na Twam afahyɛ no rebɛduru no, na Yesu nim sɛ ne dɔn aduru sɛ ɔrebɛfiri wiase akɔ Agya no nkyɛn, na sɛ ɔdɔɔ ɔno ara ne deɛ a wɔwɔ wiase no, ɔdɔɔ wɔn kɔsii awieeɛ. 2#Luka 22.3 Na wɔrebɛdidie no, na ɔbonsam anya de ahyɛ Yuda Iskariot, Simon ba, akoma mu sɛ ɔnkɔyi no mma. 3#Yoh 3.35; 16.28 Na Yesu nim sɛ Agya no de nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa, ɛne sɛ ɔfirii Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔrekɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn nti, 4ɔsɔre firii adidiiɛ, na ɔyii n’atadeɛ guu hɔ, na ɔfaa mpepaho de kyekyeree ne ho. 5Na afei ɔhwiee nsuo guu dwaresɛn mu, na ɔfirii aseɛ hohoroo asuafoɔ no nan ho, na ɔde mpepaho a ɔde kyekyeree ne ho no pepaa ho. 6Ɛnna ɔbɛduruu Simon Petro soɔ; na ɔno deɛ, ɔsee no sɛ: Awurade, wo na worehohoro me nan ho yi? 7Yesu bua see no sɛ: Deɛ mereyɛ yi, worente aseɛ seesei, na akyire yi na wobɛte aseɛ. 8Petro see no sɛ: Meremma wo nhohoro me nan ho da! Yesu buaa no sɛ: Sɛ manhohoro wo ho a, wonni m’afa. 9Simon Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛnyɛ me nan ho nko, na me nsa ne me tirim nso bi. 10#Yoh 15.3 Yesu see no sɛ: Deɛ wadwareɛ no, ɛnhia no adwareɛ, gye ne nan ho hohorɔ, na ne ho nyinaa afi; na mo ho afi, na ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa. 11#Yoh 6.64; 6.70-71 Na ɔnim deɛ ɔbɛyi no ama; yei nti na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa na mo ho afire no.
12Ɛnna ɔwiee wɔn nan ho hohorɔ na ɔfaa n’atadeɛ na ɔtenaa ase bio no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Moahunu deɛ mayɛ mo yi? 13#Mat 23.8; 23.10 Mo deɛ, mofrɛ me Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne Awurade, na moka nokorɛ, na meyɛ. 14#Luka 22.27 Afei sɛ me, Awurade ne Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no, mahohoro mo nan ho a, na ɛsɛ sɛ mo nso mohohoro mo ho mo ho nan ho. 15#Flp 2.5; Kol 3.13 Na mama mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ, sɛdeɛ mayɛ mo no, mo nso monyɛ saa ara. 16#Mat 10.24 Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Akoa nsene ne wura, na ɔsomafoɔ nsene deɛ ɔsomaa no. 17#Mat 7.24 Sɛ monim yeinom na moyɛ a, nhyira ne mo. 18#Dwom 41.9 Ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa ho asɛm na meka; me deɛ, menim wɔn a mayi wɔn. Na saa na ɛbɛyɛ na twerɛsɛm no aba mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔdi me paanoo no na wama ne nantin so atia me. 19Afei mese mo ansa na aba, na sɛ ɛnya ba a, moagye adi sɛ mene no. 20#Mat 10.40 Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Deɛ ɔgye obi a mesomaa no no, ɔgye me; na deɛ ɔgye me no gye deɛ ɔsomaa me no.
Yesu ka deɛ ɔbɛyi no ama
(Mateo 26.21-25; Marko 14.18-21; Luka 22.21-23)
21 # Yoh 12.27 Yesu kaa saa no, ne ho yeraa no honhom mu, na ɔdii adanseɛ sɛ: Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Mo mu baako bɛyi me ama. 22Ɛnna asuafoɔ no hwehwɛɛ wɔn ho anim, wɔnhunu onii korɔ a ɔne no. 23#Yoh 19.26; 20.2; 21.7; 21.20 Na asuafoɔ no mu baako a Yesu dɔ no no twere Yesu koko mu; 24ɛnna Simon Petro bɔɔ n’ani kyerɛɛ no see no sɛ: Bisa no deɛ ɔreka ne ho asɛm no. 25Enti ɔpa tweree Yesu koko mu bisaa no sɛ: Awurade, ɛyɛ hwan a? 26Yesu buaa sɛ: Ɔno ne deɛ mede paanoo sini bɛbɔ mu mama no no. Na ɔde paanoo sini no bɔɔ mu maa Yuda, Simon Iskariot ba no. 27#Yoh 13.2 Na ɔgyee paanoo sini no akyiri no, ɛno na Satan hyɛnee ne mu. Ɛnna Yesu see no sɛ: Deɛ woreyɛ no, yɛ no ntɛm! 28Na yei deɛ, wɔn a wɔte adidiiɛ no mu biara anhunu deɛ enti a ɔkaa saa kyerɛɛ no. 29#Yoh 12.6 Na ebinom susu sɛ Yuda kura kotokuo no nti, Yesu reka akyerɛ no sɛ: Kɔtotɔ deɛ ɛhia yɛn sie afahyɛ no, anaasɛ ɔmfa biribi mma ahiafoɔ. 30Ɛnna ɔgyee paanoo sini no no, ntɛm ara na ɔfirii adie; na ɛyɛ anadwo.
Ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ a ɛne ɔdɔ
31Ɛnna ɔfirii adie no, Yesu kaa sɛ: Afei wɔahyɛ Onipa Ba no animuonyam, na Onyankopɔn anya ne mu animuonyam. 32#Yoh 12.23; 17.1-5 Sɛ Onyankopɔn anya ne mu animuonyam a, Onyankopɔn nso bɛhyɛ no animuonyam ɔno ara ne mu, na ɔbɛhyɛ no animuonyam ntɛm. 33#Yoh 8.21 Mma nkumaa, berɛ tiaa bi na aka a mene mo wɔ hɔ. Mobɛhwehwɛ me, na sɛdeɛ meka mekyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ no sɛ: Faako a merekorɔ no, mo deɛ, montumi mma hɔ no, saa ara na afei mese mo nso. 34#Yoh 15.12-13; 15.17 Ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ na mema mo, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho sɛdeɛ medɔɔ mo no, sɛ mo nso monnodɔ mo ho mo ho! 35Sɛ mododɔ mo ho a, ɛnam yei so nnipa nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ moyɛ m’asuafoɔ.
Petro pa a ɔbɛpa Yesu ho nkɔmhyɛ
(Mateo 26.33-35; Marko 14.29-31; Luka 22.31-34)
36 # Yoh 7.34; 21.18-19 Simon Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛhe na worekorɔ? Yesu buaa no sɛ: Faako a merekorɔ no, wontumi nni m’akyi seesei; na akyire yi na wobɛdi m’akyire. 37Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛdeɛn nti na mentumi menni w’akyi seesei? Mede me nkwa bɛto hɔ ama wo. 38Yesu buaa no sɛ: Wode wo nkwa bɛto hɔ ama me anaa? Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, akokɔ remmɔn na woapa me mprɛnsa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Twam afahyɛ no rebɛduru no, na Yesu nim sɛ ne dɔn aduru sɛ ɔrebɛfiri wiase akɔ Agya no nkyɛn, na sɛ ɔdɔɔ ɔno ara ne deɛ a wɔwɔ wiase no, ɔdɔɔ wɔn kɔsii awieeɛ. Na wɔrebɛdidie no, na ɔbonsam anya de ahyɛ Yuda Iskariot, Simon ba, akoma mu sɛ ɔnkɔyi no mma. Na Yesu nim sɛ Agya no de nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa, ɛne sɛ ɔfirii Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔrekɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn nti, ɔsɔre firii adidiiɛ, na ɔyii n’atadeɛ guu hɔ, na ɔfaa mpepaho de kyekyeree ne ho. Na afei ɔhwiee nsuo guu dwaresɛn mu, na ɔfirii aseɛ hohoroo asuafoɔ no nan ho, na ɔde mpepaho a ɔde kyekyeree ne ho no pepaa ho. Ɛnna ɔbɛduruu Simon Petro soɔ; na ɔno deɛ, ɔsee no sɛ: Awurade, wo na worehohoro me nan ho yi? Yesu bua see no sɛ: Deɛ mereyɛ yi, worente aseɛ seesei, na akyire yi na wobɛte aseɛ. Petro see no sɛ: Meremma wo nhohoro me nan ho da! Yesu buaa no sɛ: Sɛ manhohoro wo ho a, wonni m’afa. Simon Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛnyɛ me nan ho nko, na me nsa ne me tirim nso bi. Yesu see no sɛ: Deɛ wadwareɛ no, ɛnhia no adwareɛ, gye ne nan ho hohorɔ, na ne ho nyinaa afi; na mo ho afi, na ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa. Na ɔnim deɛ ɔbɛyi no ama; yei nti na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa na mo ho afire no.
Ɛnna ɔwiee wɔn nan ho hohorɔ na ɔfaa n’atadeɛ na ɔtenaa ase bio no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Moahunu deɛ mayɛ mo yi? Mo deɛ, mofrɛ me Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne Awurade, na moka nokorɛ, na meyɛ. Afei sɛ me, Awurade ne Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no, mahohoro mo nan ho a, na ɛsɛ sɛ mo nso mohohoro mo ho mo ho nan ho. Na mama mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ, sɛdeɛ mayɛ mo no, mo nso monyɛ saa ara. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Akoa nsene ne wura, na ɔsomafoɔ nsene deɛ ɔsomaa no. Sɛ monim yeinom na moyɛ a, nhyira ne mo. Ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa ho asɛm na meka; me deɛ, menim wɔn a mayi wɔn. Na saa na ɛbɛyɛ na twerɛsɛm no aba mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔdi me paanoo no na wama ne nantin so atia me. Afei mese mo ansa na aba, na sɛ ɛnya ba a, moagye adi sɛ mene no. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Deɛ ɔgye obi a mesomaa no no, ɔgye me; na deɛ ɔgye me no gye deɛ ɔsomaa me no.


Yesu kaa saa no, ne ho yeraa no honhom mu, na ɔdii adanseɛ sɛ: Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Mo mu baako bɛyi me ama. Ɛnna asuafoɔ no hwehwɛɛ wɔn ho anim, wɔnhunu onii korɔ a ɔne no. Na asuafoɔ no mu baako a Yesu dɔ no no twere Yesu koko mu; ɛnna Simon Petro bɔɔ n’ani kyerɛɛ no see no sɛ: Bisa no deɛ ɔreka ne ho asɛm no. Enti ɔpa tweree Yesu koko mu bisaa no sɛ: Awurade, ɛyɛ hwan a? Yesu buaa sɛ: Ɔno ne deɛ mede paanoo sini bɛbɔ mu mama no no. Na ɔde paanoo sini no bɔɔ mu maa Yuda, Simon Iskariot ba no. Na ɔgyee paanoo sini no akyiri no, ɛno na Satan hyɛnee ne mu. Ɛnna Yesu see no sɛ: Deɛ woreyɛ no, yɛ no ntɛm! Na yei deɛ, wɔn a wɔte adidiiɛ no mu biara anhunu deɛ enti a ɔkaa saa kyerɛɛ no. Na ebinom susu sɛ Yuda kura kotokuo no nti, Yesu reka akyerɛ no sɛ: Kɔtotɔ deɛ ɛhia yɛn sie afahyɛ no, anaasɛ ɔmfa biribi mma ahiafoɔ. Ɛnna ɔgyee paanoo sini no no, ntɛm ara na ɔfirii adie; na ɛyɛ anadwo.

Ɛnna ɔfirii adie no, Yesu kaa sɛ: Afei wɔahyɛ Onipa Ba no animuonyam, na Onyankopɔn anya ne mu animuonyam. Sɛ Onyankopɔn anya ne mu animuonyam a, Onyankopɔn nso bɛhyɛ no animuonyam ɔno ara ne mu, na ɔbɛhyɛ no animuonyam ntɛm. Mma nkumaa, berɛ tiaa bi na aka a mene mo wɔ hɔ. Mobɛhwehwɛ me, na sɛdeɛ meka mekyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ no sɛ: Faako a merekorɔ no, mo deɛ, montumi mma hɔ no, saa ara na afei mese mo nso. Ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ na mema mo, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho sɛdeɛ medɔɔ mo no, sɛ mo nso monnodɔ mo ho mo ho! Sɛ mododɔ mo ho a, ɛnam yei so nnipa nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ moyɛ m’asuafoɔ.


Simon Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛhe na worekorɔ? Yesu buaa no sɛ: Faako a merekorɔ no, wontumi nni m’akyi seesei; na akyire yi na wobɛdi m’akyire. Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛdeɛn nti na mentumi menni w’akyi seesei? Mede me nkwa bɛto hɔ ama wo. Yesu buaa no sɛ: Wode wo nkwa bɛto hɔ ama me anaa? Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, akokɔ remmɔn na woapa me mprɛnsa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
